startup.boundary: Byte fetch/file I/O excluded. First explicit compile in this run (engine cache state unknown), then first instantiate from compiled module. Wrapper init includes Rust fixed scratch setup and dispose. Cached-module batches instantiate fresh memories; wrapper init timed as separate batch. Repeated instantiation includes async Promise overhead; no claim of cold engine cache.

lifetime.boundary: Synchronous single-threaded wrapper use. Raw exports are trusted instance-level access, not an owner security boundary. Counters measure live documents and logical UTF-16 units. Linear memory can retain allocator capacity; no allocator, GC, RSS, or production leak claim.

boundary.limitation: Observed standalone path costs. JS optimization, call loop, JIT, GC, typed-array machinery and copies remain in the stated boundaries. No subtraction estimates pure ABI overhead or allocator cost. Reused copies exclude payload allocation; fresh output includes allocation plus copy. No editor or CRDT claim.

lifecycleBatches.boundary: Complete raw create/read/close cycle batches with one live handle at a time. Includes host input copy, Rust document allocation/copy, Rust read materialization, fresh host output allocation/copy, Rust drop, assertions and view creation. Prepared UTF-16 input and checksum excluded. Phase observations remain in combinedTextTape.lifecycle; these aggregate cycles avoid interpreting short single-operation times as zero. No pure allocator estimate.

lifecycle.boundary: Independent initial-document encode, create+input copy, materialize+output copy, decode and single-handle close phases; no edits; instance and buffers already initialized

timingBoundary.jsString: string edits only; initial text, operation preparation and final hash excluded
timingBoundary.wasmPerEditInputCopy: one wrapper call, integer checks, input UTF16 copy and Rust splice per edit; initial create and final read/hash excluded
timingBoundary.wasmPerEditInputAndFullOutputCopy: same per-edit input path plus Rust output copy, read call and JS-owned Uint16Array copy per edit; string conversion excluded
timingBoundary.wasmWholeBatch: one call including Rust initial allocation, PRNG, edits and final hash; no text crosses ABI

combinedTextTape.limitation: TextTape Vec baseline, no CRDT/editor integration. Cross-path times have different boundaries; no isolated estimate of ABI overhead or production speedup.
